name: Holger Timm
forbes_bio: Holger Timm is the founder and controlling shareholder of German investment company, Effektengesellschaft.
Timm founded the company as a stock brokerage in 1986 and owns about 88% of the publicly traded business.
The Berlin-based company offers financial services, including brokerage, financial advisory services, investment funds and venture capital.
Through a subsidiary, it launched an all-day trading platform call Tradegate in 2001, whose investors now include BNP Paribas.

name: Igor Kudryashkin
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2018-2024); Hurun Global (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Igor Kudryashkin is the commerce director of Iskander Makhmudov's Ural Mining Metallurgical Company (UMMC), a top Russian producer of commodities such as copper, zinc, coal and gold.
Kudryashkin received shares in UMMC when Makhmudov reorganized the business in 2013.
Kudryashkin and his family hold more than two-thirds of European Media Group, which boasts 8 radio stations with about 35 million listeners each week.
forbes_facts: Kudryashkin's daughter sings under the name Nastya Kudri; in 2015, she recorded a song called "Father."

name: Azman Hashim
forbes_bio: Azman Hashim is the former chairman of AmBank Group, Malaysia's sixth-largest lender by assets. He acquired it in 1982 as the Arab-Malaysian Development Bank.
His bank holding company AMMB Holdings is the listed flagship.
Azman retired in 2022, though he remains chairman emeritus.
Azman also has stakes in RCE Capital and Amcorp Properties, which his daughter Shalina is non-executive chairman.
Azman has been in the banking industry since 1960, when he joined Bank Negara Malaysia.
forbes_facts: Azman wears many other hats: He is the president of the Malaysia South-South Association, Malaysia-Japan Economic Association and the Malaysian Prison Friends Club.
One of Azman's three daughters, Shazrina, is a local artist who is known as Mizz Nina.
Azman has climbed Mount Kinabalu - which stands between Myanmar and Papua New Guinea - twice. The second time was in November 2023 at the age of 84.

name: Chamath Palihapitiya
forbes_bio: Chamath Palihapitiya is a Silicon Valley venture capital investor who has made himself into a tech firebrand.
He is a proponent of SPACs - a kind of investment vehicle that allows private companies to go public with less scrutiny from the SEC.
Palihapitiya is a sponsor and investor in half a dozen SPACs. Companies they have merged with include Virgin Galactic and Clover Health.
He is also founder of Social Capital, a venture capital firm that he started in 2011; the firm faced a wave of defections in 2018.

name: Geng Diangen
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2020-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Hurun China (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Geng Diangen is the founder and former chairman of Beijing Sinnet Technology, a supplier of Internet data services.
Sinnet was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2014.
Gen, who started the company in 1999, resigned as chairman in 2022.

name: Muneaki Masuda
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2011-2021); Hurun Global (2014-2016)
forbes_bio: Muneaki Masuda founded and runs Tsutaya, Japan's largest bookstore and movies, music and game-rental chain.
He took the company private in 2011, paying $850 million.
He also owns about 1% of Japanese e-commerce firm Rakuten.

name: Bernard Charles
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026)
forbes_bio: Bernard Charles is the CEO of Dassault Systèmes, the software and consulting arm of French aviation giant Dassault.
Charles joined Dassault Systèmes to develop new design technologies two years after it was co-founded in 1981 by billionaire Charles Edelstenne.
In 1989, he was part of the inspiration behind digital mock-up, allowing design engineers to produce full-blown 3D models of products.
A trained engineer, he became Chairman of Dassault Systemes board in January 2024.
He holds the rank of Commander in the ?Légion d?honneur? (French Legion of Honor).
forbes_facts: Charles has been a Dassault board member for 30 years and is one of the highest-paid CEO's in France.

name: Amit Burman
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2019-2026); Hurun India (2018-2020)
forbes_bio: Amit Burman is the fifth-generation scion of the storied Burman clan, which controls consumer goods company Dabur.
An MBA from Cambridge University, he started off in Dabur's industrial engineering department where he worked on mechanization and packaging.
He went on to lead Dabur's foray into processed foods spanning the gamut from cooking pastes to fruit juices.
He resigned as non executive chairman in August 2022 and is now a non-executive director on the board.
Falguni Nayar, the billionaire founder of beauty and fashion retailer Nykaa sits on Dabur's board.
forbes_facts: Apart from a minority stake in Dabur, he also has stakes in other privately held businesses such as restaurant chain Lite Bite Foods.
In 2020, Burman acquired a stake in No Worry No Tension Healthcare, a startup that uses artificial intelligence to gauge emotional wellness.

name: Shao Zengming
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2022); Hurun Global (2022-2023); Hurun China (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Shao chairs Henan Liliang Diamond, a supplier of synthetic diamond products.
